requirements.title: Uppercase normative keyword force
requirements.normative_statement: Only the exact uppercase keywords MUST, MUST NOT, SHOULD, SHOULD NOT, and MAY carry normative force; lowercase uses are descriptive.

requirements.title: Stable identifiers on normative clauses
requirements.normative_statement: Every new or materially changed normative clause MUST cite at least one stable requirement identifier.

requirements.title: Permanent requirement identity
requirements.normative_statement: Allocated requirement identifiers MUST NOT be renumbered, reused for another meaning, or deleted, and terminal requirement records MUST be retained.

requirements.title: Durable typed governance records
requirements.normative_statement: Material architecture decisions, change proposals, risks, deviations, and semantic questions MUST have durable typed governance records.

requirements.title: Immutable base ontology
requirements.normative_statement: The nine-coordinate base ontology MUST remain immutable.

requirements.title: Scoped mutable state
requirements.normative_statement: Every mutable state change MUST be truth-scoped, typed, and provenance-bearing.

requirements.title: Perception cannot rewrite shared truth
requirements.normative_statement: Perception state MUST NOT rewrite shared truth.

requirements.title: Distinct coordinate and identity concepts
requirements.normative_statement: A coordinate index or bit position, an ordinal, a presentation order, a realm or plane identity, and a full vector or state identity MUST be treated as distinct concepts and MUST NOT be inferred from one another without an explicit mapping.

requirements.title: ASH symbolic grammar ownership
requirements.normative_statement: The ASH Cosmological Model MUST own the upstream symbolic grammar used by YWE.

requirements.title: Pinned ASH dependency identity
requirements.normative_statement: The ASH dependency identity MUST be content-addressed and pinned by a deterministic digest.

requirements.title: Wolf resonance canonical term and alias
requirements.normative_statement: wolf_resonance MUST be the canonical field, wolf_alignment MAY be accepted only as a read or migration alias, and the dual-variable model MUST NOT be interpreted as a moral axis.

requirements.title: Append-only accepted event history
requirements.normative_statement: Accepted event history MUST be append-only.

requirements.title: Compensating reversal and correction
requirements.normative_statement: A reversal or correction MUST be represented by a new compensating delta and MUST NOT erase or rewrite the accepted event.

requirements.title: Truth-authority monotonicity
requirements.normative_statement: A lower truth-authority layer MUST NOT overwrite a higher layer's constraints.

requirements.title: YWE Core and WRW scope separation
requirements.normative_statement: A WRW-specific rule MUST NOT become normative YWE Core truth.

requirements.title: Authoritative ASH source and deterministic mirror
requirements.normative_statement: core/ash_pattern_engine/canonical MUST be the authoritative ASH specification source, and specs MUST remain its deterministically synchronized generated mirror.

requirements.title: Durable decision rationale
requirements.normative_statement: Every material decision MUST retain a durable rationale.

requirements.title: Single canonical glossary definition
requirements.normative_statement: Each glossary concept MUST have exactly one canonical definition.

requirements.title: Exact offline schema catalog coverage
requirements.normative_statement: The schema catalog MUST cover every declared schema exactly once, match each file's absolute identifier, and resolve all schema references locally without a network dependency.

requirements.title: Explicit fixture bindings and exact rejection witnesses
requirements.normative_statement: Each fixture MUST declare an explicit schema identifier and instance pointer, match its recorded result and complete set of rejection error identifiers, instance pointers, and schema pointers, and a failed fixture MUST NOT remove its example from the schema debt inventory.

requirements.title: Compatible Phase 12 string and array representations
requirements.normative_statement: The Phase 12 truth_scope_summary, visibility_conditions, resolution_mode_options, and expected_consequence_classes fields covered by ADR-0012 MUST accept nonempty legacy strings and nonempty arrays of nonempty strings while retaining their required-field lists and existing quest_title_policy contract.

requirements.title: Source-backed YAML module manifest structural validation
requirements.normative_statement: YAML fixture mappings MUST have unique string keys and JSON-representable values without scalar type coercion. Module capability manifests MUST satisfy the source-declared root required fields, structural types and enums, and retain at least one non-delegable responsibility for foundational_truth or structural_runtime_truth authority.

requirements.title: Truthful roadmap-derived M2 readiness and executed repository evidence
requirements.normative_statement: The M2 readiness evaluator MUST map every ordered exit criterion and deliverable, fail while any is failed or unverified, and accept repository evidence only for the clean matching revision and catalog with an unfiltered, offline local run of all applicable passing checks.

requirements.title: Compatible historical player object representations
requirements.normative_statement: Historical PlayerRuntimeState ash_provenance, authority_boundary, update_policy, and PlayerRuntimeStateDelta changed_fields members MUST accept nonempty legacy strings and open objects while preserving existing required members and array constraints.

requirements.title: Explicit explanatory example formats
requirements.normative_statement: Historical future-bias, truth-scope collection, and quest axiom-pressure preview bindings MUST certify only their declared explanatory formats and MUST NOT imply canonical runtime packet or complete domain semantic acceptance.

requirements.title: Source-declared pattern archetype structural validation
requirements.normative_statement: Pattern archetype and cluster bindings MUST enforce the structural required fields, types, enums, nested required members, and cluster member minimum explicitly declared by the YWE-owned YAML descriptor without interpreting descriptive hints as new assertions.

requirements.title: Explicit descriptor grammar and meta-reference validation
requirements.normative_statement: YAML descriptors MUST satisfy their declared structural grammar and owned semantic checks for required-name membership, enum and record references, duplicate enum values and inheritance cycles. Structural validation MUST precede semantic validation; descriptive hints MUST NOT create assertions.

requirements.title: Execute ability invariants and historical negative descriptions
requirements.normative_statement: Ability synergy MUST retain not_morality_system=true and decoherence MUST retain temporary=true as already required by their owning checks. Historical ability and Phase 12 negative-description format acceptance MUST remain separate from executed source-bound assertion or materialized-scenario rejection.

requirements.title: Source-bound intended rejection evidence
requirements.normative_statement: Every registered rejection scenario MUST bind the unchanged source description and owning assertion, validate a mutation control before changing it, and match its complete intended error or lexical witness set. Rejection-description format acceptance MUST NOT substitute for an executed rejection; collection cases MUST each have an executed witness.

requirements.title: Exact protected Phase 9 representation correction
requirements.normative_statement: Protected Phase 9 representation corrections MUST preserve every original descriptive value and migration proof, retain formerly accepted nonempty strings, and admit the observed typed container or numeric representations through explicit assertion transitions. Validation MUST reconstruct the immutable original migration and reject undeclared edits or unreviewed baseline stages.

requirements.title: Conservative Ravenfall preview formats
requirements.normative_statement: Ravenfall and recovery preview descriptions MUST satisfy their explicit serialized format grammar while retaining incomplete acceptance status, descriptive truth labels, open containers and source-unrestricted empty values. Format acceptance MUST NOT certify absent canonical runtime packet fields or playtest acceptance.

requirements.title: Explicit YAML policy document formats
requirements.normative_statement: Domain YAML policy and descriptor documents MUST satisfy their declared structural document grammars. Literal descriptor tokens MUST retain their source scalar types, heterogeneous optional records MUST retain their explicit variants, and descriptive policies MUST NOT be executed as unrecorded domain algorithms.

requirements.title: Executed validation operation cases
requirements.normative_statement: Recovery, replay and migration fixture categories MUST count only exact accepted operation cases with successful complete executed stages. Recovery MUST reject the diagnosed proposal and accept the restored original; replay MUST independently reload identical inputs; migration MUST execute the immutable protected schema proofs. Validation operations MUST NOT mutate their sources or claim later runtime lifecycle protocols.

requirements.title: Governed positive expectation identities
requirements.normative_statement: Accepted fixtures MUST carry unique nonempty expected requirement identifiers that resolve to active registered obligations. Additional contract-specific identifiers MUST match the exact selected schema annotation and its registered source ownership. Fixture-governance identity MUST NOT be advertised as complete domain-clause traceability.

requirements.title: Source-bound realm rejection assertions
requirements.normative_statement: Each declared unlawful realm guidance unit MUST bind its complete identity, summary and violated-rule list to executed source-owned rejection assertions. Assertion vectors MUST preserve typed boolean inverses and exact witnesses, and MUST NOT certify unrepresented runtime transition fields.

requirements.title: Executed M2 validation methods
requirements.normative_statement: Every roadmap validation method MUST execute concrete nonempty method-specific cases and report complete successful evidence. Source-driven properties MUST exercise source enum members and required-field removals; isolated assertion mutants MUST be killed by their exact accepted and rejecting controls. Method labels alone MUST NOT establish conformance or certify runtime behavior.

requirements.title: Immutable source-bound M2 acceptance evidence
requirements.normative_statement: M2 acceptance MUST preserve the actual complete clean unfiltered offline execution report, all roadmap judgments, concrete operation and method executions, and the exact tested source state. Its first passing introduction MUST change only the fixed evidence pair; later evidence changes or deletion MUST fail verification. Historical replay MUST execute the preserved implementation and MUST NOT promote pending or uncommitted claims.

requirements.title: Approved descriptor execution correspondence
requirements.normative_statement: Every source-bound rejection scenario MUST match a separately reviewed descriptor-to-execution contract before it can discharge intended-reason coverage. The approved contract MUST preserve the exact descriptor identity and reason bindings, mode, scope, subject or base, operations, complete witnesses, and source owners. Unknown, duplicate, missing, altered or unused approvals MUST fail the complete catalog check. A candidate scenario catalog MUST NOT authorize itself.

requirements.title: Source-bound immutable state assessment
requirements.normative_statement: StateModel MUST construct immutable exact F2^9 states and produce complete source-bound diagnosis and contextual assessment records using an explicit immutable profile binding and the ordered canonical classifier. Its bounded codec MUST reject lossy numeric or representation coercion and retain truthful malformed-input evidence. Consulted predicates MUST use subject/profile/assessment-bound evaluated facts; unconsulted unavailable facts MUST NOT become inferred boolean values. Acknowledged diagnostics MUST survive subsequent capture or evidence failures. The legacy facade MUST expose diagnosis-only output and MUST NOT infer system class, recovery execution or complete Diagnostics conformance.

requirements.title: Verified semantic normalization with retained actual computation
requirements.normative_statement: StateModel MUST preserve the complete submitted diagnosis and current explicit immutable bindings when planning or validating normalization. It MUST rederive original semantics, complete reachable targets, identity-first or full-signature selection and the canonical XOR proof at use. Pure planning MUST NOT require capture or execute correction. Application MUST compute the actual value and validate it under the same profile, immediately capture every required diagnostic and publish normalized output only after matching confirmations. Unverified origins MUST NOT seed acknowledged chains; capture failures MUST preserve actual observations and the confirmed prefix without claiming success.

requirements.title: Verified immutable recovery and source-bound fallback execution
requirements.normative_statement: RecoveryEngine MUST validate the complete original assessment under the current model before capture or effects, retain actual original class and source bindings, and use only explicit verified normalization, supplied known correction or deterministically ordered certified registry entries. Each actual value or predicate step and fresh full postassessment MUST receive matching capture confirmation before further effects or recovered-value certification. Every failure MUST retain actual observations and pending directives. N2 handoffs MUST NOT claim mode entry, authority contact or live session publication.

requirements.title: Bounded reference Diagnostics with protected safe graph and paired export
requirements.normative_statement: Reference Diagnostics MUST validate exact producer records, admit bounded operations, persist their complete safe supporting graph before confirmation, and retain actual completion, loss, health and source availability. It MUST redact untrusted data before persistence and independently validate safe output before paired JSON/Markdown publication. Clock and protected storage truth MUST come from explicit typed ports. Unknown capture, completion or storage MUST NOT be reported as confirmed. Reference qualification MUST NOT imply native release substitution or complete canonical producer coverage.
